Fahmi owns estimands/analysis; Clarence supplies the frozen builds/manifests. Every condition in a family shares the SAME terminal DecisionEnvelope per task — only the interface differs — so an interface effect is not confounded with a backend difference; L_reliance binds to that shared decision (CA-1 / C-BLOCK-15).
principle: Within a surface family, all conditions resolve the identical terminal DecisionEnvelope per task; only presentation/interaction differs (C-BLOCK-06). validate_conditions.py checks projected-digest equality across the family.

vintage_note: All conditions and tasks run at this single frozen vintage; validate_conditions.py fails if any task resolves an envelope at a different vintage. Nothing may run two conditions at different vintages (Fahmi review, 2026-08).
origin_publisher_note: origin + publisher are recorded per task so leakage-safe splits (PD-6) and CAL-RISK clustering can be built over them (Fahmi review). Values here are DEMONSTRATION placeholders; real feed origins/publishers attach when the benchmark set is minted.

benchmark_requirements._comment: The tasks below are DEMONSTRATION FIXTURES for the C-BLOCK-06 confound-proof, NOT a benchmark task set (Fahmi review, 2026-08).
benchmark_requirements.rationale: At three tasks the crossed-design power ceiling is ~0.18 on illustrative variance components; a usable target needs ~20+ tasks. The benchmark set is minted jointly with Fahmi, who owns the power target, sampling and annotation (RATIFY-14-07/08).
benchmark_requirements.status: PENDING — benchmark task set not yet minted

repair_minting._comment: F-BLOCK-09 / WP §13.1. When a P2 conversation changes the INTERPRETED query, the changed query is a DIFFERENT task, minted here — never a silent same-envelope change.
repair_minting.convention: A repaired task sets "repair_of": <base task_id>, uses a distinct task_id, and carries its own scenario/envelope. It is exempt from same-envelope-as-base equality (the changed query is the point); within its own family it still shares one envelope across conditions.

scenario_overrides._comment: MUST stay empty. Any per-condition override of a task's scenario would confound the interface effect with a backend difference (C-BLOCK-06). The validator fails if a family's conditions do not all resolve the same decision per task.

identification_honesty: P2 − P1 is NOT a same-envelope cosmetic interface effect if conversation changes the interpreted query. Any such change is recorded as a different task/decision, never silently (WP §13.1).
tuning_freeze: Treatment tuning (wording/layout/logic) freezes before locked exposure. Post-freeze accessibility/security repairs are classified; if they change semantics or task flow, the affected conditions are versioned and re-run (WP §13.4).
no_study_fallback: If ethics/recruitment/readiness fails: retain deterministic conformance, accessibility/AT, semantic-replay / non-interference / security tests; remove usability, practitioner-actionability, organisational-effectiveness and lived-equity claims (WP §13.5).
owner: Clarence builds the frozen conditions; Fahmi owns estimands, sampling, annotation and analysis (RATIFY-14-07/08).

review_dispositions._comment: Disposition of Fahmi's evaluation-stream review of this manifest (2026-08), feeding C-BLOCK-06 / F-BLOCK-09.
